headline: Snap Reaches Settlement with Teens Over Depression and Eating Disorder Lawsuits
summary: Snap has reached a settlement with teenage plaintiffs in a lawsuit concerning platform-related depression and eating disorders, following prior settlements by Meta, TikTok, and Google's YouTube.
why: Legal settlements regarding platform safety and minor addiction pose regulatory and financial risks for social media companies, influencing compliance and liability costs.

impacts.name: Snap Inc
impacts.why: Resolving litigation removes legal uncertainty but involves settlement costs and compliance obligations.
